description: Equip your New Zealand business with autonomous AI agents running 24/7 in cloud computers. Automate research, coding, calls, and workflows effortlessly.
h1: Autonomous AI Agents Built for New Zealand
sub: Deploy dedicated cloud bots that work around the clock across global time zones, handling coding, web research, and client workflows while you sleep.
audience: Auckland founders, Wellington public-sector consultants, Christchurch agritech innovators, exporters, and Kiwi digital teams managing global clients across time zones.
manifesto: Operating from Aotearoa means navigating opposite time zones and lean teams. Ceyo gives every Kiwi enterprise tireless cloud agents that research, code, and coordinate international operations overnight so you wake up steps ahead.

uses.d: Schedule agents to track commodity prices, foreign distributor updates, and regulatory filings in Europe and North America while New Zealand sleeps.
Let your coding bot build, run, and test telemetry scripts and web dashboards on its isolated cloud computer without slowing down your local machine.
Connect over 1,000 tools like Google Sheets, Slack, and Notion so bots reconcile client reports and update campaign deliverables automatically.
Deploy research agents to compile legislative analyses and synthesis reports with persistent memory shared across your entire specialist bot team.
Handle customer queries and client bookings across Australian and Pacific time zones with voice-enabled agents linked directly to your calendar.
Assemble coordinated bot teams inside Telegram group chats where your researcher, copywriter, and data analyst collaborate on projects in real time.

steps.d: Select Plus, Pro, or Ultra to start your 3-day trial with 1,000,000 daily tokens.
Give each specialist agent their own goals, apps, scheduled routines, and cloud browser.
Chat, make voice calls, or let your bots collaborate autonomously in group channels.

chapters.d: You check Telegram over flat white coffee to find your overnight bot has scanned European markets and drafted a client summary in Google Docs. Everything ran autonomously on its dedicated cloud computer while your laptop was closed.
Your specialist bot team reconciles invoices across your CRM, updates project boards in Notion, and alerts your team on Slack. Each bot retains shared memory, eliminating repetitive status checks.
Need a quick client portal? Your coding agent builds, executes, and deploys full-stack code directly within its secure cloud machine without touching local environments.
As New Zealand logs off, scheduled cloud routines activate to monitor international supply chains and execute price tracking across US and UK websites.

faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost in New Zealand?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three simple tiers: Plus ($20/month), Pro ($60/month), and Ultra ($120/month). Every subscription starts with a 3-day free trial featuring up to 1,000,000 tokens per day. Your card is linked during signup and is only charged once the trial concludes unless cancelled.

faq.q: How do Ceyo cloud computers work when my device is off?
faq.a: Each of your bots runs inside an isolated, secure cloud virtual environment with its own browser, storage, and runtime. Even when your phone, laptop, or internet connection is switched off, scheduled routines and multi-step tasks continue running uninterrupted 24/7.

faq.q: Can I use Ceyo through Telegram and phone calls?
faq.a: Yes. You can interact with individual bots or invite multiple specialist bots into a shared Telegram group chat where they coordinate together. Bots can also execute autonomous web browsing, manage phone-call tasks, and join voice or video calls.

faq.q: What apps and integrations does Ceyo connect with?
faq.a: Ceyo integrates with more than 1,000 tools, including Gmail, Google Sheets, Slack, Notion, calendars, and leading CRMs. Bots can read shared documents, update records, and pass context between platforms automatically.

faq.q: Does Ceyo support multiple languages and local data needs?
faq.a: Ceyo bots communicate fluently in English, Māori, and dozens of international languages. Your bots store documents and memory in private cloud environments, ensuring consistent context across all deep research and analytical work.
